CheckTitle: Forced password rotation is disabled for general users
Description: Checks active password policies do not force blanket periodic password rotation.
Risk: Forced rotation without evidence of compromise can encourage weaker user password choices.

Code.Other:
1. In the Okta Admin Console, open the general-user password policy.
2. Edit password age settings.
3. Set password expiration to never expire for standard users unless a documented exception applies.
4. Retain forced reset procedures for known or suspected compromise.
5. Save the policy and document any regulated exceptions.

Recommendation.Text: Disable forced periodic password rotation for general users unless a regulation or compromise event requires it.

Notes: Requires the Okta read scopes documented for the referenced management APIs.
